name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: New: BroodMinder sensors. Add a sensor to a hive, tap Read sensors in the yard, and see weight and temperature charts; tap a point for details.
The voice screen says "Buddy is talking" while Buddy reads a question, then Mic ON when it listens.
Fixed: the "Before saving" box stays above the keyboard while you type.
New: you can choose to send crash reports to help us fix problems faster. Nothing is sent unless you say yes; change it any time in Settings > Help & support.
My club is split into short tabs: Club, Equipment, Swarms, and Officers for officers. "See it as a member" shows what members see.
The voice screen shows Mic ON, Mic Paused or Mic OFF in big letters, and the mic lets go when you leave the app.
Fixed: meeting check-ins could be lost when several came in at once.
Fixed: Buddy speaks again, so hands-free inspections start right away.
Joining a club with weak cell service now says to try again, instead of saying no club has your email.
Problem reports now go to support@beeyardwingman.com.
